items.item_text: 1+ years Front desk or bell attendant experience in a hotel environment

The UCLA Luskin Conference Center is seeking a customer-focused, dynamic Bell Attendant to deliver exceptional service to our guests and visitors. As the primary point of contact upon arrival and departure, you will set the tone for a world-class hospitality experience on the UCLA campus. Key Responsibilities Guest Welcome & Escort: Warmly greet arriving guests, open doors, and escort visitors to their rooms. Transport guest luggage to and from rooms and designated storage areas. Room & Property Orientation: Identify and explain specific room features to guests. Provide comprehensive information regarding center amenities, services, hours of operation, and local Los Angeles attractions or campus activities. Concierge & Logistics Support: Supply clear directions, communicate parking procedures and rates, and arrange transportation (taxis, shuttles, ride-shares), including recording advance travel requests. Luggage Management: Handle luggage storage, tag items accurately, and manage prompt retrieval upon request.
Ability to engage with diverse populations in a respectful and culturally responsive manner
Ability to remain calm in the face of adversity, such as customer dissatisfaction

Skill in interacting effectively with guests, team members, and managers in a high-volume, public setting using positive body language, direct eye contact, active listening, and friendly and professional demeanor
Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment with a fluctuating workload
Ability to work cooperatively as a part of a team
Ability to sufficiently communicate in written and verbal English to receive work assignments and share information with supervisors, colleagues, and guests
Ability to comply with safety standards and procedures for both personal and public safety
Ability to maintain regular, punctual attendance
